recommendation_summary: Act now: keep the existing shared order list, sort it by pickup date (earliest first) or add a 'Due today' filter at the counter, and have staff prepare only today's (then tomorrow's) unprepared orders before starting anything later. Add a closing check that tomorrow's orders are prepared or scheduled. No optional present additions; the reply advises cancelling the Odoo partner booking and revisiting only if cakes are still missed after a couple of weeks. Unmet needs: none.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need every cake due today prepared before pickup; nobody has asked for new sales, inventory, or manufacturing tracking.
labels.Deleted: Odoo and the implementation partner. Payments and stock already reconcile correctly, and the order list already holds the pickup date.
labels.Bottleneck: Cakes are prepared in the order they were entered instead of by pickup date, so next month's cakes got made before today's.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me. Every order has customer, pickup date, and status, and the list is readable at the counter. I have not seen the list.

note: Bounded due-date sort/filter on the existing list with Odoo explicitly deleted; the only revisit is conditional on later failure, and the checks rely on supplied facts with the inspection limit stated.
